headline: Integrative methods recover structured states from paired and multi-omics data
label: Integrative Multi Omics Structure Recovery
summary: Paired and multi-omic single-cell and bulk datasets now permit joint recovery of subtypes and regulatory modules from heterogeneous measurements.
synthesis: The common thread across these items is recovering organized biological structure from heterogeneous, multi-layer measurements. Meta-pLGG applies a weighted meta-clustering framework over random-projection features and six base clusterers to resolve five pediatric low-grade glioma subtypes. q-intNMF uses joint non-negative matrix factorization on paired scRNA and scATAC data, showing comparable benchmark performance with better efficiency. WGCNA+ extends weighted gene coexpression network analysis to multi-omics integration, adding SVD-accelerated overlap, cross-dataset consensus modules, and LASAGNA visualization. What is new is joint decomposition and network integration across modalities rather than single-layer analysis. The thread is not uniform: the meta-clustering and network items address subtype resolution and module discovery, while q-intNMF targets paired-modality factorization.
